{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check distribution of missing 'sex' by species
missing_sex_by_species = penguins[penguins['sex'].isnull()]['species'].value_counts()
print(missing_sex_by_species)

# Also check overall sex distribution
sex_distribution = penguins['sex'].value_counts()
print("\nSex distribution across all data:")
print(sex_distribution)"}
